The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Wagdy Eid Mansour, tested by Eng. Taher Abdel Galil El-Khatib, endorsed by General Manager Eng. Yousry Ahmed Abdel Maksoud, reviewed by Eng. Abdel Monem El-Emam, Manager of the Instruments and Electricity Department in the Inspection Sector of the East Delta Electricity Production Company, and approved by Eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab, Head of the Talkha Power Station Sector.

It was endorsed by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality at the East Delta Electricity Production Company and MPIS Coordinator, and approved by Mr. Mahmoud Mohamed Sleiman, General Manager of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.

Fence off the area and use the appropriate warning signs
Use occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Inform all users that the telephone lines will be shut down during the maintenance work

rows:
Test the input and output voltages of the power supply unit and make sure they are as follows:
Input: 220 Vac.
Output: (+ 12, + 5.15, 5.1, - 48) Vdc
Disconnect the power supply feeding the cards
Remove the system cards and clean the bases with spray
Test the cables of each line
Clean the cable junction box with the blower
If a damaged cable is found, replace it with a new one
Measure the line voltage and make sure it is -48 Vdc, via the terminal block in the box
If there is no -48 Vdc, perform a reset via the (CPUS 545) card
If there is still no -48 Vdc after the reset, follow up the repair using the relevant drawings.

Introduction
This document sets out the calibration steps I1 to be carried out annually, as indicated by the code Y1 above.
The system consists of:
Power supply unit: + 5.15, - 5.1, + 12, -48 Vdc
6 control cards
Interface card
(Interface Card)
Capacity 90 lines (26 lines in use)
4 junction boxes
Power supply unit: + 5.15, - 5.1, + 12, -48 Vdc
6 control cards
Interface card
(Interface Card)
Capacity 90 lines (26 lines in use)
4 junction boxes
The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Wagdy Eid Mansour, tested by Eng. Taher Abdel Galil El-Khatib, endorsed by General Manager Eng. Yousry Ahmed Abdel Maksoud, reviewed by Eng. Abdel Monem El-Emam, Manager of the Instruments and Electricity Department in the Inspection Sector of the East Delta Electricity Production Company, and approved by Eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab, Head of the Talkha Power Station Sector.
It was endorsed by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality at the East Delta Electricity Production Company and MPIS Coordinator, and approved by Mr. Mahmoud Mohamed Sleiman, General Manager of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.
Safety precautions
Issue a work order, with an industrial safety category card available for the site workers
Fence off the area and use the appropriate warning signs
Use occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Inform all users that the telephone lines will be shut down during the maintenance work
Tools and equipment used
Suitable tool kit, occupational safety and health equipment
Digital voltmeter, Fluk 187
Complete tool kit
Dry air blower
Contact cleaning spray
Procedures to be carried out
Test the input and output voltages of the power supply unit and make sure they are as follows:
Input: 220 Vac.
Output: (+ 12, + 5.15, 5.1, - 48) Vdc | 1.
Disconnect the power supply feeding the cards | 2.
Remove the system cards and clean the bases with spray | 3.
Refit the cards | 4.
Test the cables of each line | 5.
Clean the cable junction box with the blower | 6.
If a damaged cable is found, replace it with a new one | 7.
Reconnect the power supply | 8.
Measure the line voltage and make sure it is -48 Vdc, via the terminal block in the box | 9.
If there is no -48 Vdc, perform a reset via the (CPUS 545) card | 10.
If there is still no -48 Vdc after the reset, follow up the repair using the relevant drawings. | 11.
